entities.name: P42536
observations: Exact 591-residue sequence match to reviewed Acholeplasma phage L2 protein; UniProt annotates it as a membrane, multi-pass membrane protein.
Reference annotation identifies transmembrane helices at residues 389-409, 411-431, 538-558, and 571-591.
Protein is 66.6 kDa, predicted acidic (pI 4.68), and lacks a reported Pfam domain in the performed scan.
The N-terminal approximately 380 residues are non-hydrophobic and form a large soluble domain followed by multiple membrane-spanning helices.
Functional annotation remains uncharacterized; exact sequence identity supports localization but not a specific molecular activity.
